# Fit Txt

Fit Txt is a private beta SMS fitness accountability service for people in the United States and Canada. It helps users stay honest with health and fitness goals through direct text-message check-ins, reminders, follow-up, and accountability support.

Fit Txt does not provide medical care, diagnosis, treatment, dietetic advice, or certified personal training. Users should consult qualified professionals for health, diet, injury, or training decisions.

## Key Pages

- https://fittxt.com/ - Beta signup for Fit Txt, a free text-message fitness accountability service.
- https://fittxt.com/how-it-works.html - Explains how Fit Txt uses SMS check-ins, AI-powered accountability, optional human support, and STOP/HELP controls.
- https://fittxt.com/privacy.html - Privacy policy for Fit Txt beta signup, SMS messages, support, and service providers.
- https://fittxt.com/terms.html - Terms of service, text-message controls, and health disclaimers.

## Core Facts

- Fit Txt is currently a private beta.
- Fit Txt is designed for SMS/MMS accountability, not a downloadable mobile app.
- Fit Txt works in the United States and Canada.
- Users can reply STOP to unsubscribe from messages and HELP for support details.
- Premium accountability may include additional human support alongside AI-powered check-ins.
- Support email: help@fittxt.com
